entrypoints.summary: The report demonstrates the top-level secp.getPublicKey API receiving Boolean true as its private-key argument.
Point.fromPrivateKey derives a public point by passing its privateKey argument to normalizePrivateKey and multiplying the base point.

affected_components.role: Private-key normalization feeds base-point multiplication during public-key derivation.
Post-fix regression oracle rejects true, false, and other invalid private-key values.

code_slices.fixed: normalizePrivateKey explicitly validates Uint8Array length, string length, safe positive integers, and positive bigint values below CURVE.P; unsupported values throw TypeError.
code_slices.surrounding_context: Point.fromPrivateKey invokes normalizePrivateKey before Point.BASE.multiply; the patch adds a getPublicKey invalid-input test including Boolean values.
code_slices.vulnerable: The audit reproduces the reported pre-fix Point.fromPrivateKey call path and identifies insufficient input type checking.

sources.concept: Boolean value supplied as a private-key argument

impact.affected_asset: Correctness and secrecy assumptions of private key material handled by deployments using the API.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause a caller or upstream type-mangling path to submit Boolean true as a private-key input and obtain the scalar-1 public key.
impact.security_effect: Predictable key-pair basis when a private-key input is mangled to Boolean true instead of being rejected.

causal_trace.summary: A JavaScript caller supplies Boolean true where the public-key API expects a private-key value.
The pre-fix path did not sufficiently reject the Boolean runtime value, despite the private-key representation being intended to be Hex, bigint, or number.
Private-key derivation passes the normalized scalar into base-point multiplication; the report observed that JavaScript treatment of true yielded the same public key as scalar 1.
The API deterministically produces the public key associated with scalar 1 for Boolean true, so mangled private-key input can be treated as a predictable key basis rather than rejected.

failure.operation: Base-point scalar multiplication after private-key normalization

primary_invariant.kind: cryptographic private-key runtime representation and range validation
primary_invariant.statement: Public-key derivation must accept only explicitly represented, valid private-key values and reject Boolean and other invalid runtime values before scalar multiplication.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The reported pre-fix API accepted true, and the report's transcript shows its output equaling getPublicKey(1).

quality.review_notes: The audit supplies a concrete pre-fix equality oracle and identifies the affected path; the inspected fix diff supplies strict predicates and a Boolean rejection test. The exact vulnerable release/commit and an observed test-run result are not present in the bundle.

remediation.invariant_restored: The fix accepts Uint8Array and string inputs only at 32-byte/64-hex-character lengths, accepts numbers only when safe positive integers, accepts bigint only when positive and below CURVE.P, and throws for all other values; the added test includes true and false among rejected inputs.
mitigation_classes: rejection tests for invalid key inputs
